rain.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_reached_checkout, sessions_that_completed_checkout WHERE landing_page_path = '/products/waterproof-film-for-car-rearview-mirror' AND hour_of_day <= 17 GROUP BY day SINCE 2026-11-05 UNTIL 2026-11-12 ORDER BY day ASC LIMIT 10
